# Navisworks build reference

`2027\\Autodesk.Navisworks.Api.dll` is the Autodesk Navisworks Manage 2027 API
reference used only to compile the Federation Automation visual-style add-in.
It is not copied into the add-in or either Federation Automation executable.

This permits executable builds on machines that do not have Navisworks
installed. Creating or saving Navisworks federation files still requires a
licensed installation of Navisworks Manage. Keep and distribute this Autodesk
assembly only in accordance with the licence that applies to your Navisworks
Manage installation.
